title: Bushing with the Mullins effect
description: The bushing made with mesh tools in a filled rubber, which softens after its first loading (the Mullins effect, Ogden-Roxburgh). The inner sleeve is moved radially by 6 mm and back, by 6 mm again, which needs less force, and on to 9 mm, where the rubber is as stiff as at its first loading. The contour of the maximum strain energy density shows where the rubber is softened.
